_about: How real orchestral string sections time slurred note changes: f0 leave / mid / arrive of each change (slurred and bowed) against the same section's own attacks (the beat as that section plays it) and against the other sections' attacks. Derived numbers only, no audio. Branch-free research for the fork's Performance-legato timing (docs/RESEARCH.md task 2, OPEN_ITEMS 2-3). 2026-10-21.

source.audio: The Spheres dataset (Colibri Ensemble at The Spheres studio; arXiv 2511.21247; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.17347681), CC BY-SA 4.0. Mozart, Symphony No. 40 K. 550, movement 1, Multichannel set, each section's own close stem: Violin_1/Violin_1, Violin_2/Violin_2, Viola/Viola, Cello/Cello, Bass_1/Bass. Each part was recorded in its own session, with a conductor, the players hearing reference recordings (Bernstein) for synchronisation (paper, sec. on recording). Stems fetched whole by HTTP range requests from the zip (deflate: a time range can't be cut out remotely), measured, deleted.
source.score: Breitkopf & Haertel full score, IMSLP #492601 (the edition of the earlier accent study); bar numbers as printed. Readings: review/ (crops next to each reading).
source.sso: SSO's side: the solo-section + click clips the owner judged on 2026-10-21 (.mixedtech/page/clips, from the heard checks w0/w1 (Whence bars 5-14) and m0/m1 (Mixed techniques bars 1-4) of plain-timing / solo-clicks: Kontakt 8 + SSO on the Windows VM, build #458 export), measured here with the same change() as the Spheres stems.

method.f0: YIN (legato_glide/f0.py's algorithm, vectorised: scripts/yin.py): 2.5 ms steps, 30 ms frames (Basses 40), the pair's pitches +-2 semitones, a 5-frame median, gaps <= 30 ms interpolated. phi = share of the way from the note before's measured pitch (median +-40 ms around its centre) to the new one's.
method.times: rule: mid = first time phi stays >= 0.5 for 20 ms; leave = last time phi <= 0.1 before mid; arrive = first phi >= 0.9 after mid. fit (the headline numbers): a logistic fitted to the raw cents within +-100 ms of mid (vibrato as noise): leave / mid / arrive = its 10 / 50 / 90 % points. Synthetic checks (scripts/calib.py): mid within +-8 ms in every case; a step reads 10-25 ms wide (the floor of a 'glide' width); a solo semitone with 25-cent vibrato can misplace leave / arrive by up to ~80 ms (sections average it out), so semitone leave / arrive are the least certain numbers.
method.beat: attack readings of every bowed note by the fork's heard-check rule (tools/playbackverify/heard_check.attack_time: -15 dB under the note's peak on the perceived envelope, less 30 ms; note-on taken 25 ms after the envelope's dip), the same yardstick that times SSO's attacks (plainAttack) and the heard check. 'own' = a local weighted linear fit (pos in quarters -> s, +-6 quarters, tricube) of the same section's other attack readings (the note itself left out); 'others' = the other four sections' readings; 'othersCorrected' = others less the section's own median offset in that passage play. fitMid_ownSlope: own map from the envelope's max-slope times instead (a physical-onset convention).
method.quality: headline statistics use changes with own-map SE <= 20 ms, no unvoiced gap > 30 ms, logistic RMS < 40 cents; passage M1 b44-51 (few attacks: the map spans up to 8 quarters) only for glide widths.
method.statistics: medians; 90 % intervals by a two-level bootstrap (passage plays, then changes within them; 1500 draws, seed 1).
